_comment: FameEX 各站点的本地验证配置。端口固定：登录态（cookie/localStorage）按 origin 保存，换端口就丢。{port} 会被替换。后台统一连 test 环境（dvmkgi）；legacy 的代理目标经 legacy-vue.config.cjs 覆盖，不改仓库文件。

admin.start: cp config/environments/.env.test .env.development.local && NEXT_PUBLIC_LOCAL_DEV=true NEXT_PUBLIC_ORIGIN=http://localhost:{port} pnpm exec next dev --port {port}

futures-admin.start: cp config/environments/.env.test .env.development.local && NEXT_PUBLIC_LOCAL_DEV=true NEXT_PUBLIC_ORIGIN=http://localhost:{port} pnpm exec next dev --port {port}

legacy-admin.start: VUE_CLI_SERVICE_CONFIG_PATH=$HOME/.ai-rules/skills/prd-to-commit/scripts/legacy-vue.config.cjs P2C_ORIGINAL_VUE_CONFIG=$PWD/vue.config.js P2C_PROXY_FROM=pfyys.com P2C_PROXY_TO=dvmkgi.vip npx vue-cli-service serve --mode test --port {port}

futures-legacy-admin.start: VUE_CLI_SERVICE_CONFIG_PATH=$HOME/.ai-rules/skills/prd-to-commit/scripts/legacy-vue.config.cjs P2C_ORIGINAL_VUE_CONFIG=$PWD/vue.config.js P2C_PROXY_FROM=pfyys.com P2C_PROXY_TO=dvmkgi.vip npx vue-cli-service serve --mode test --port {port}
